parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
Specifies the time-based sorting order of service invocation records in the response. Valid values:

- 0: reverse chronological order.
- 1: chronological order.

> **StartTime** must be earlier than **EndTime**. The system automatically converts the values based on the sorting order.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name to query.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the service to query.

- For weak validation, you can view the service **Identifier** of the device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) to view it in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.
- For validation-free mode, this value must be the same as the custom **identifier** reported by the device.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.

><notice> **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page. The service returns this token in the first request. Include it in the second request to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the service invocation records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.
